results.title: Initially delayed, the pass-through of tariffs to consumer prices has arrived

results.content: How tariff-induced inflation proceeds from here is an open question, complicated by several countervailing forces. There’s some evidence that tariff passthrough to consumer prices has stabilized in recent months, following the U.S. Supreme Court’s decision to strike down many tariffs imposed last year. Some companies that received tariff refunds have said they will pass those refunds on to customers in the form of lower prices. But at the same time, new tariffs are on the table, and the [...] suggests nearly 90% of the economic incidence of recent tariffs fell on U.S. firms and consumers, rather than on foreign exporters.
